title: Editor experience: agent skills for TYPO3
description: Editors type on the page, publish when they are ready, see records as cards and boards, and get a well-configured rich-text editor. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 92 seconds: Editor experience, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-visual-editor, typo3-workspaces, typo3-records-list-types, typo3-ckeditor5). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: Editors want to click into the page and type, not fill in forms.
Editor experience: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Prepares templates so editors click into the page and type, with every output traceable to its record.
In the Visual Editor: click the headline, type, save. The record is updated.
Prepares content in a workspace, then reviews and publishes it, with the file traps named.
A preview that shows the live page, or images that lose their references on publishing, are the usual surprises.
Shows records as grid, teaser, timeline or board views in the Records module, set in TSconfig.
Grid, timeline, catalogue: editors switch views, and nothing in core is patched.
Configures RTE presets and builds CKEditor 5 plugins for TYPO3.
CKEditor 5 is a complete rewrite with no compatibility layer for version 4, so old plugins need a plan.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
